description: Connect IQ companion watch app contract: settings, pairing token, and the read-only status endpoint. Today the watch polls a household HTTPS gateway; in the phone app the same endpoint is served by the embedded web server (see 11-garmin.md section 11 for the HTTPS caveat and the Connect IQ Mobile SDK alternative).

app.name: TreadmillRunner
app.sdkValidated: Connect IQ SDK 9.2.0, warning-free builds for all six products

settings.title: Gateway HTTPS URL
settings.prompt: Optional HTTPS address from TreadmillRunner watch setup

pairedModeCondition: gatewayUrl is a string starting with 'https://' AND watchToken is a string of length >= 20; otherwise the footer shows 'Standalone' and no request is made

statusRequest.pollEvery: on view show, then every 30 s while the view is visible; never more than one request in flight

statusResponses.case: valid token, this profile owns the active non-terminal session
valid token, no active session for this profile, or the active session is Completed/Stopped/Interrupted/Faulted
missing header, not 'Bearer ', token length outside 20..128, unknown or revoked hash

statusSideEffects: A successful lookup updates the binding's LastSeenAtUtc. It never acquires a treadmill lease and exposes no command.

watchHandling.result: runnerName property overwritten with runnerName; sessionTitle shown; footer = state string (or 'Connected' if missing)

pairing.create: POST /api/integrations/garmin/watch/profiles/{profileId} {deviceLabel (1..100)} over HTTPS or loopback only, idle runner only => {binding, token, message: 'Copy this token now. TreadmillRunner stores only its SHA-256 hash and cannot show it again.'}
pairing.replace: Creating again replaces the profile's single binding (new hash, LastSeen cleared, Version+1)
pairing.get: GET /api/integrations/garmin/watch/profiles/{profileId} => binding {id, userProfileId, runnerName, deviceLabel, createdAtUtc, lastSeenAtUtc, version} or 204
pairing.revoke: POST /api/integrations/garmin/watch/profiles/{profileId}/revoke {expectedVersion} idle only => 204 | 404 | 409 on version mismatch
